sections.content:
29,435 people

were counted on the census as "elementary sales occupations (other)" in England and Wales in March 2021.
People who do this type of work do a variety of elementary sales related occupations not elsewhere classified.

People who had this job were generally younger

The occupation of "elementary sales occupations (other)" had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 20 to 24 years. Of the whole working population 7.9% were aged 20 to 24 years. For people working as "elementary sales occupations (other)", 18.9% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "elementary sales occupations (other)" was 65 years or older.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "elementary sales occupations (other)" included:

  • kitchen and catering assistants
  • sales and retail assistants
  • elementary construction occupations (other)

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "elementary sales occupations (other)" there were more women than men (55.2% compared with 44.8%).

This means "elementary sales occupations (other)" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "elementary administration and service occupations".

Men made up 44.8% and women made up 55.2% of "elementary sales occupations (other)"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "elementary sales occupations (other)" included:

  • solicitors and lawyers
  • fitness and wellbeing instructors
  • sales supervisors - retail and wholesale

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "elementary sales occupations (other)" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "elementary sales occupations (other)" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "elementary sales occupations (other)", 11.7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a younger age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work part-time than full-time (63.7% compared with 36.3%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (98.7%) than self-employed (1.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
